CustomField.description: Comma-separated values that mark a row as AUM rather than a trade, for example AUM, BAL, POSITION. Compared case-insensitively against the column mapped to rowType, or the transactionType column when no rowType column exists. Blank means the file has no AUM rows.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: List the values this firm uses to mark AUM rows, separated by commas.
CustomField.label: AUM Indicator Values
